Retry supplies `refresh_reason = free_models_update_retry` without `provider_id`. “`View details` is a no-persist disclosure” of the existing activation, quarantine and rollback records. Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md:8683–8684 supplies refresh and list, and :8710 marks the onboarding retry “Source lineage only; no command or alias.” Under DL-2603, Plans/Models_System.md:8481 says “No ranked top-10 store exists, and the ranked top-10 editor is retired.” Plans/FinalGUISpec.md:29065,29075 binds `Use for a job` to one Default models job row at the chosen layer, saved through Settings preview/apply. Plans/Section15_MVP_Promoted_Features_Spec.md:10045–10055 names the minimum fields for all eleven records. At :19313 the wire form is “one JSON object (RFC 8259, UTF-8) with exactly the record's minimum fields plus `record_type`” and the constant schema_version 1.0.0. Unknown and mistyped fields are refused. The eleven typed rows at :19319–19329 match the eleven field lists. For example, ingestion specifies stages, byte_count, refusal reasons and its diagnostic destination, while backpressure specifies its throttle states and web GUI/diagnostic destinations. At :19301 “Their owner is the engine instance of the one terminal session named by `terminal_session_id`”, with the starting engine owning profile resolution. The engine keeps bounded live history and drops it when the session ends.

original.evidence: Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md:22092–22095 gives `cmd.github.actions.settings.open` the Settings subview and says “Both are route/open commands with no persisted event”. The production wiring maps it to `handlers::github::actions_settings_open`. Current Branch also has a route, and :22098–22100 gives individual dispositions for `cmd.actions.show`, `cmd.actions.switch_subview` and `cmd.github.actions.open_run_diff`. The legacy `/Workflows/Settings` route resolves to the Settings command. At :625,628 `cmd.docker.build` is the “Compatibility alias for the selected `cmd.docker.build.*` path”, and `cmd.docker.build.image` explicitly builds in Image mode. These dispositions give the UCC-047 and UCC-049 preserved tokens operational meanings.

Plans/orchestrator-subagent-integration.md:31935–31939 gives the four import mappings, including “`verify_tier_end -> VerifyUnitEnd`”, and requires the canonical hook_name_normalized in records. OSI-177 at :17133 prescribes “BeforeUnit/AfterUnit hooks” and marks the tier spellings import-only. OSI-180 at :17325–17327 now requires AfterUnit validation and spells its stored name “hook_name_normalized = AfterUnit”. OSI-184 at :17619–17621 says “BeforeUnit runs before VerifyUnitStart” and requires AfterUnit validation before VerifyUnitEnd. The affected accepted units now use the same execution order and names as the alias table.

Plans/orchestrator-subagent-integration.md:12173 (OSI-099) chooses the phase gate: “The phase gate is the one mechanism”. It fires on `architecture_technology` phase completion at Full or Short depth with require_architecture_confirmation enabled. The required card records explicit user Confirm in the validation artifacts. Change retains the note and keeps the phase open. False or Skip bypasses it. The same unit says “There is no timeout and no agent self-confirmation.” OSI-089 at :11587 also says “Only the user's Confirm completes that phase” when the soft question cap has been reached. This implements DL-2602.

Plans/Section15_MVP_Promoted_Features_Spec.md:19301 assigns every record to its session’s terminal engine, with profile resolution owned by the engine starting that session. The engine “drops any remaining live history when the session ends”, with :19303 limiting it to 1,024 records and 1 MiB per session across all eleven types. At :19313 the boundary format is “one JSON object (RFC 8259, UTF-8)” with a constant type and schema version. Each of the eleven minimum field lists at :10045–10055 has a typed row and named destination at :19319–19329. At :19307 the frame, scrollback anchor and accessibility snapshot “are never in” a diagnostic bundle. At :19309 only a redacted TerminalDiagnosticsEnvelope may also enter the ordinary terminal diagnostic log. The restart rule restores none of the eleven records.

Plans/Section15_MVP_Promoted_Features_Spec.md:9951–9959 publishes the SMPFS-100 columns, including “action_id | bucket | default_timeout_ms | output fields | tier”. The share row names `guaranteed_everyday`, its 30,000 ms timeout and outputs share_receipt_id, target_agent_id and artifact_refs[]. The evaluation and DevTools rows name advanced_debug_testing. The two live capture-to-chat rows name guaranteed_everyday. At :9963–9979 DL-2604’s rule says “A command takes the highest level any of its effects reaches”, classifies all 50 named command spellings and assigns program.pause, cancel and inspect to the advanced tier by explicit exception. The rendered seven rows each have eleven cells, and their explicit tiers agree with the rule.

Plans/orchestrator-subagent-integration.md:184–190 confines enable_tier_subagents and tier_overrides to compatibility import and requires normalization through SubagentPolicy. OSI-425 at :31436–31444 names `pm.subagent_policy.v1` for live admission. OSI-078 at :10931 gates ExecutionRequest propagation on admission of that unit, saying of the legacy flag “it is never read as the runtime gate”. OSI-081 at :11109 says “Runtime admission reads only the normalized SubagentPolicy.” OSI-214 at :19595–19599 applies normalized overrides per admitted execution unit, filters disabled entries and adds required entries, with required winning. The old flag and per-tier map no longer provide parallel runtime switches.
